        if cls.internal:

        result=[]
        def add(iname):
            ic=self.class_lookup(iname)
            if not ic: return
            if ic.name not in result: result.append(ic.name)
            # Parent interfaces of an interface follow it
            parents=[]
            if ic.parent: parents.append(ic.parent)
            for p in ic.interfaces:
                if p not in parents: parents.append(p)
            for p in parents: add(p)
        for iname in cls.interfaces: add(iname)
        if cls.parent:
            pc=self.class_lookup(cls.parent)
            if pc:
                for iname in reversed(self.all_interfaces_of(pc)): add(iname)
